steps.name: prompted-task-events-only
steps.detail: Pre-case: `ATM_IDENTITY=fx-at11-alpha ATM_TEAM=fx-at11 atm teams clear-nudge-template --team fx-at11 --kind task_reminder --json` -> {"action":"clear-nudge-template","team":"fx-at11","kind":"task_reminder","cleared":false}. Case 1: assigned 3 tasks to fx-at11-beta via `atm task assign fx-at11-beta "..." --task-id at11-c1-tN-20260915T043519Z --json` -> {"task_id":"at11-c1-t1-20260915T043519Z"} (and t2, t3). Polled `atm task events at11-c1-t1-20260915T043519Z --json` every 5s; task1 handoffs progressed task_queued(04:35:22.833Z) -> task_ready(04:35:23.960004405Z) -> task_reminder(04:36:28.962852528Z, attempt 1) while task2/task3 events showed only: events=[{"event":"assigned",...}], handoffs=[{"kind":"task_queued",...}] (no ready/reminder). Observed interval = 04:36:28.962852528Z - 04:35:23.960004405Z = 65.002848123s (documented default ~60s, matches within scheduler jitter). Started task1 as beta: `atm task start at11-c1-t1-20260915T043519Z "starting case1 task1" --json` -> {"action":"send",...,"outcome":"sent","task_id":"at11-c1-t1-20260915T043519Z",...}. Final `atm task events at11-c1-t1-20260915T043519Z --json` events array in order: assigned(seq1), reminded(seq2, 04:35:23.960004405Z), reminded(seq3, 04:36:28.962852528Z), started(seq4, 04:36:40.522623251Z, to_state=active); handoffs array in order: task_queued, task_ready, task_reminder, task_started. Task1 shows queued+ready+reminder+started in order; task2/task3 remained queued-only throughout. PASS.

steps.name: disabled-reminder-doctor-finding
steps.detail: `ATM_IDENTITY=fx-at11-alpha ATM_TEAM=fx-at11 atm teams disable-nudge-template --team fx-at11 --kind task_reminder --json` -> {"action":"disable-nudge-template","team":"fx-at11","kind":"task_reminder","updated_at":"2026-09-15T04:36:52.610822534Z"}. Assigned new task: `atm task assign fx-at11-beta "AT11 case2 task1 20260915T043654Z" --task-id at11-c2-t1-20260915T043654Z --json` -> {"task_id":"at11-c2-t1-20260915T043654Z"}; assigned event at 04:36:54.527608906Z. Waited via foreground Bash polling loops (sleep 5 x N, each call <=100s) until 2026-09-15T04:39:14.450556102Z, i.e. 139.92s elapsed since assign, exceeding required observed-interval*2 = 130.0057s. `atm task events at11-c2-t1-20260915T043654Z --json` at that point: events=[{"event":"assigned","at":"2026-09-15T04:36:54.527608906Z",...},{"event":"reminded","actor":"daemon","at":"2026-09-15T04:36:58.958834112Z",...}], handoffs=[{"kind":"task_queued","at":"2026-09-15T04:36:54.527Z",...},{"kind":"task_ready","at":"2026-09-15T04:36:58.958834112Z",...}] -- only task_queued and task_ready present, no task_reminder handoff and only one 'reminded'-named event (the ready promotion), no second reminder. `atm doctor --json --team fx-at11` reported: {"severity":"warning","code":"ATM_WARNING_OBSERVABILITY_HEALTH_DEGRADED","message":"disabled_task_nudge_template_override: team fx-at11 has disabled `task_reminder`","remediation":"atm teams clear-nudge-template --team fx-at11 --kind task_reminder"}. PASS.
